name: badge
purpose: Use Badge only for a number attached to something else (unread count, 12, 99+). For the state of a resource use StatusIndicator, for a category or outcome word use Tag, for a removable or selectable token use Chip, and for the "+N" of a truncated list use OverflowCount. Badge is a compact, non-interactive count with severity-based color coding, commonly overlaid on icons, avatars or buttons, or set beside a heading. It differs from its sibling `tag`: `tag` carries words (optional leading icon, optional pill shape, masked surfaces), whereas `badge` carries a number on a fully filled surface with no icon affordance.
useWhen: A number attached to another element: a bell with its unread count, a section heading with how many items it holds.
Color the count through `variant` (the brand look: `primary`, `secondary`) or `severity` (neutral / info / success / warning / danger) with a fully filled surface; `severity` wins when both are set.
avoidWhen: A status word (Active, Failed, Deploying) → use `status-indicator`.
A category or outcome word (Production, Beta, Allowed) → use `tag`.
The label is user-removable or selectable → use `chip`.
The "+N" that opens the hidden items of a truncated list → use `overflow-count`.
related: `tag` — labelled status/category chip with optional icon and pill shape; use when the label is descriptive, not a count.
`chip` — interactive/removable token; use when the user can select or dismiss it.
bestPractices: Keep the content to a number (`12`, `99+`); words belong in `tag` or `status-indicator`.
Drive color from `variant` or `severity`, never a hardcoded color or a raw palette class.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback text when the default slot is empty.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Brand look of the badge surface and label, used when `severity` is not set.

props.name: severity
props.doc: Status colour of the badge surface and label; wins over `variant` when set. `neutral` uses the `var(--bg-surface)` / `var(--text-default)` surface. The values are the shared `Severity` scale (exported from this component).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; `small` is 20px tall, `medium` is 24px, `large` is 30px.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Main content; falls back to `label` when empty.
